title: Assault on Nijmegen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Assault on Nijmegen", at revision 1376437479, opens: "The Assault on Nijmegen occurred on the night of August 10, 1589, involving troops of the mercenary Maarten Schenck van Nydeggen against the small garrison and some citizens at the city of Nijmegen." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2511359, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Maarten Schenk van Nydeggen fails to take the city by surprise during the Eighty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
